checks: Normalization preserves the centroid and domination. The ordinary volume component has positive mass on the interior and forces each supporting linear functional to have strictly submaximal mean. Moving a containing cap to the centroid reduces both measured masses. A proper through-centroid cap has 0<s<1, and both measures vanish on its continuous boundary.

Cap inclusion and ordinary d-dimensional Brunn–Minkowski make the volume-tail root V^(1/d) concave. Its tail is continuous and strictly decreasing across the projection interval, including when d=1, so the ordinary-volume pushforward is uniform and the dominated pushforward has density in [0,1]. Jensen gives (1) with the ordinary contribution d/(d+1). Separate left filling on [0,s] and [s,1] uses exactly the feasible lengths r and α−r, and includes α=0,1 and r at either feasibility endpoint.

Division by q s^q and substitution of α=s(Q+E−1) give φ(U)+2φ(Q)+2φ(E)≥2/(d+1). Maximizing each φ(z)+az gives the stated positive-part expression, including a≤−1. The weighted linear terms sum to D/d, and the right side of (2) simplifies exactly to 1+4A_d/3−ε_d.

For real d≥14, monotonicity of A_d and 8·15^14>21·14^14 imply L_d>5/2. Checked both exponential series comparisons exactly, as well as the coefficient sums 31/8+33/(20d) and 31/8+15/(8d). The logarithm estimate applies when the negative base correction leaves positive base; its positive part is zero in the other case.

For 1≤d≤14, the derivatives establish the required decreasing P and positive-base power, and increasing fixed-ℓ negative-base power, including its zero-to-positive transition. Since L_d is increasing, replacing L_d by L_a and then d by b bounds the final subtraction in the required direction. For [1,3/2] and [3/2,2], checked the exact margins 7/486 and 23/288 using A_d≥2 and sqrt(4/3)<7/6. Independent rational substitution gives interval floors 85,25,20,66 and all thirteen diagonal floors as printed.

Substituting (1+α)/s=D+(4A_d/3)E−1 yields s+r≥(3Γ_d/4)(1+α+ε_d s); dropping the nonnegative contribution of ν in (1) gives s≥Γ_d/(1+2α)^d≥Γ_d/3^d. Undoing normalization yields the stated surplus uniform in H.

overlap.comparison: Metronoid cap bound applied to the density (1_K+dη/dx·2)/3 gives an ordinary cap lower bound Γ_d(|K|+2η(K))/3. It does not prove the joint cap bound with coefficient 3Γ_d/4 and uniform surplus at this centroid.

The accepted mixed three-fiber theorem only cites the original pending weight-two theorem for comparison. Its alternative selector and two-cut bound do not imply the present assertion for an arbitrary dominated measure on one body.

summary: The proof gives a dimension-dependent uniform positive surplus for every halfspace at the specified weight-two centroid. Its scalar positivity holds over the full real range d≥1; the geometric assertion uses integer d only.
